title: BATWA v2.4.7 Direct Card View & Cleaned Services
message: Naya update live ho chuka hai! Card option par click karte hi direct Card Screen khulti hai jis mein sirf card ki cheezein (Card Number, Expiry, CVV, Freeze Card, Online toggle) mojood hain.
features: Direct Card Navigation: Tapping Cards immediately opens Virtual Card screen without 4-5 dummy service blocks
Purged dummy card services ('Virtual Visa', 'Order Physical', 'Card Limits', 'Card Security')
Streamlined Card screen: Only authentic card controls (Hide/Show CVV, Copy Number, Add Card, Freeze Card, Online toggle)
True zero-meter fresh account support with Rs 0.00 initial state
New modern Batwa Booting screen with Sign In & Register buttons
